baseline.entry_point: Frozen DPR Reader relevance -> fixed Top-50 -> Top-5
baseline.code_revision: Pinned DPR revision 38f47a4986084c53447ba92ab0a83076b58d86a8; runner source hashes recorded at execution
baseline.equivalence_test: Each head's zero residual initialization exactly equals frozen Reader scores.

core_invariants: Retrieval, evaluation candidates, production selector, Generator and evaluator remain unchanged.
All online heads accept only frozen Reader signals; Silver is opened after every arm ranks every case.
All trainable arms share weak train-only containment labels, cases, order, loss, optimizer and epochs.
Semantic quantum and classical arms share projection initialization and exact parameter count.
Positive consensus retention is primary; fixed Silver membership is only secondary.
No real-data screen, model or dataset download on development servers.
Historical config/output remain frozen; decoupled projection-only decay and dimension-only projection LR are isolated optimizer repairs.

interfaces.input_schema: 50 raw relevance scores plus N x 5H semantic pooled representations or N x 4 scalar features
interfaces.output_schema: 50 scores, four encoded coordinates, eight observables, gate, bounded residual, stable Top-5

plugins.hypothesis: Raw Reader relevance remains the stable anchor.
plugins.input_schema: 50 relevance scores and fixed candidate identity/order
plugins.resource_estimate: Same single minibatched Reader pass shared by all arms; deterministic sorting

plugins.insertion_point: Frozen Reader final encoder hidden state and relevance head
plugins.hypothesis: Question-conditioned semantic features provide missing information for applicability-gated quantum residual ranking.
plugins.input_schema: CLS, question mean, question-conditioned passage mean, product and absolute difference; no target fields
plugins.output_schema: Bounded anchored score, encoding, observables, gate/residual, Top-5
plugins.resource_estimate: 15399 trainable parameters at H=768, including 15364 classical projection and 16 circuit parameters; 4 qubits, 8 CNOT gates

plugins.insertion_point: Same semantic boundary as quantum arm
plugins.hypothesis: Separate richer representation benefits from the quantum interaction choice.
plugins.input_schema: Identical semantic input, initial projection, training cases and optimizer
plugins.output_schema: Classical anchored scores, encoding, observables, gate/residual, Top-5
plugins.resource_estimate: Exactly same 15399 parameter budget at H=768; diagonal classical interaction and identical readout

input_refs: same registered input and training population
shape_dtype_normalization: same shapes/dtypes as quantum semantic arm

plugins.insertion_point: Same Reader pass; historical scalar-feature Q-ARCG boundary
plugins.hypothesis: Test whether representation changes help under the same weak target and training budget.
plugins.input_schema: Cohort-normalized relevance, span score, span margin and localization features
plugins.output_schema: Scalar Q-ARCG scores, features, observables, gate/residual, Top-5
plugins.resource_estimate: 35 trainable parameters; not a parameter-matched semantic control

composition.merge_rule: Independent scores from the same frozen Reader pass; no feedback or inter-arm selection.
interaction_ablations: semantic vs scalar quantum under same weak supervision

validation.baseline_equivalence: All initial heads reproduce raw Reader scores exactly.
tests: real DPR API without checkpoint download

reproducibility.dataset_identity: 512 nq_open/train weak cases; fixed 100-case detail SHA256 669ce1018ec502f02bf2a4a76420c7cb9b4e2f17b250c5420b6bcf01fc1d5731
reproducibility.environment: Collaborator-local Torch/Transformers and existing Wiki-DPR; resolved environment recorded

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: All 100 eval x 50 pooled/scalar/base and all arms; complete final hidden for first candidate of first two usable train and first two eval cases; first two train cases traced each epoch.
trace_contract.target_boundary: Weak target only during training; Silver only after all online selections.
required_representations: per-step data-gradient norms in numeric archive
optimizer moments/steps before and after first-two training witnesses per epoch

trace_readiness.structural_validation: Project validate_trace_file reopens JSON and archive, validates population, methods, hash, identity and ordering.
trace_readiness.semantic_validation: validate_values verifies finite shapes, declared hidden sample coverage, pooling and residual bounds.
trace_readiness.replay_test: Reopen initial/epoch/witness checkpoints and all detached inputs; replay first-two training witnesses and every eval arm. Test fixture is synthetic only. Repaired witnesses additionally replay AdamW moments and one optimizer update.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Paired positive/direct retention and rescued/harmed passage ranks for semantic quantum versus scalar quantum and matched classical semantic with identical weak targets.

gates.selection: Positive evidence paired mean >0 and bootstrap lower bound >0 vs Reader, with direct evidence mean delta >=0.
gates.attribution: Positive evidence paired mean and lower bound >0 vs matched classical semantic, assessed separately.
gates.coverage: At least 25 percent of 512 training questions yield mixed weak positive/negative candidates.
gates.claim_ceiling: L0; exposed panel, weak targets and one short run are not independent full-data validation.
gates.learning_health: Pass frozen train-only collapse guard before evaluating all 100 cases; preserve failure checkpoint on abort.

limitations: No quantum advantage claimed; classical projection dominates trainable count.
Semantic vs scalar is not a parameter-matched comparison.
Failure of this short run is inconclusive for the broad trained family.
Project-level v2 validator; no claim of compatibility with the old generic v1 validator.

repair_contract.prior_disposition: stop unchanged configuration pending evidence repair
repair_contract.qualification_rule: 64 alternating updates on first two saved training cases; no evaluation arrays or Silver opened

health_contract.probe_cases: first two usable training cases only
health_contract.data_gradients: finite nonzero projection/readout/scale after null; current check window

repair_contract.next_task_run: collaborator only; no automatic development-server experiment
repair_contract.qualification_result: Both fan-in-scaled arms passed; coupled Adam and unscaled AdamW failed strengthened input-dependent correction gate. Checkpoint/moment/signal replay exact.
repair_contract.qualification_hash_policy: Qualification report/source identity uses CRLF-normalized bytes; raw execution hashes remain recorded.
